findings.title: ConstantThinkNodeRoot throws for every pawn whose race has no constant think tree
findings.detail: Source/TitanAI.cs:128 reads `___pawn.thinker?.ConstantThinkNodeRoot`. That property is `ConstantThinkTree.thinkRoot` with no null check (Pawn_Thinker.cs:13), and every pawn has a thinker, so `?.` does not help. When the race has no constant tree it throws a NullReferenceException. This runs every 30 ticks for every pawn, before the titan check and outside the try/catch. Vanilla's own method checks for a null ConstantThinkTree first (Pawn_JobTracker.cs:786), but a postfix still runs after that early return. Core mechanoids only get MechConstant with Biotech (Races_Mechanoid.xml:34), so in a game without Biotech every mechanoid, plus any modded race without the field, throws into TickList's 'Exception ticking' and loses the rest of its tick. Build 31 introduced this. Fix: `var root = ___pawn.thinker?.ConstantThinkTree?.thinkRoot;`.

findings.title: Titans of races with no constant tree now never get ability AI
findings.detail: Because of the new `root == null` early return, a titan whose race (or a content mod's race) has no thinkTreeConstant never runs JobGiver_TitanAbilities. In build 30 it did. This is deliberate according to the comment, but it changes behaviour that content-mod users may notice.

findings.title: The catch logs once per def and retries quietly, without vanilla's error-recovery job
findings.detail: Vanilla's catch in DetermineNextConstantThinkTreeJob calls JobUtility.TryStartErrorRecoverJob. This one logs once per def and then fails silently every 30 ticks. The ErrorOnce key `shortHash ^ 0x7A11` is a small number and could collide with another mod's key, which would only hide one log line.
